summary: Admin panel feature tested end-to-end (backend pytest 18/18 + Playwright UI flow). Admin Login link on title screen -> /admin, wrong creds error, correct creds griblin/Casey123! show panel with stats (90 accounts / 70 chars), search by email & char name & no-match empty state, account expand with char table (level/gold inputs, gear score, status), reset password (player login with new pw 200, old pw 401), edit level/gold persisted after reload, level>100 shows validation message, delete character, delete account (removes chars; login fails afterwards), logout returns to login form. Auth guards: no token / player JWT -> 401 on all admin endpoints. Brute-force lockout confirmed 429 (also blocks valid creds). Only throwaway admintest_*@test.io accounts were touched and all were cleaned up; lockout records cleared from DB so admin login works again. No /play or WebSocket used.

minor.issue: Lockout identifier uses request.client.host, which is the Kubernetes ingress pod IP (observed 10.231.129.156 / .157), not the real client IP. Effect: lockout is effectively GLOBAL - any anonymous visitor submitting 5 bad admin passwords locks the real admin out for 15 min (and can keep doing so: DoS). Fix: derive IP from first entry of X-Forwarded-For header (fallback to client.host).
Credentials compared with != (not constant-time). Use hmac.compare_digest for username and password.

issues: 'Admin Login' link at bottom is very low contrast (dim text/border on dark forest background) - fine if intentionally discreet
Chevron/date/char-count cluster floats at ~85% width leaving an odd empty gap at the right edge of each account header
In expanded char table the row bottom borders stop before the Save/Delete action cell (borders misaligned)

action_items: Use X-Forwarded-For (first IP) for the login lockout identifier in admin_login and login so lockout is per real client, not global
Use hmac.compare_digest for admin credential comparison
Optional: minor alignment polish on admin account header and table row borders
critical_code_review_comments: CharRow local state (useState(c.level/c.gold)) is not re-synced when props change on Refresh; if a value changes server-side (e.g. player levels up in game) the input shows stale value and 'dirty' compares against new props - add useEffect to reset on c.level/c.gold change
Admin JWT shares JWT_SECRET with player tokens; separated only by type claim - acceptable but a separate secret would be safer
Admin token stored in sessionStorage (XSS-readable) - acceptable for MVP
seed_data_creation: Created throwaway admintest_*@test.io accounts + Tst* characters; all deleted. Cleared admin:* lockout records from login_attempts after the lockout test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_admin_panel.py. Lockout test was done manually (not in pytest file) because it locks admin for 15 min; clear db.login_attempts identifiers starting with 'admin:' afterwards.
